description: Generates a production-aware cinematic lighting plan from zone data and a lighting style. Selects key/rim/fill/practical/volumetric settings from the named preset, evaluates light balance, and produces ordered transaction operations. Planning only — no bridge calls, no mutations.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.semantic_lighting_engine import get_semantic_lighting_engine


class HouMCPCinematicLightingNode(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_cinematic_lighting"
    category = "Houdini"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.icon_path = "icons/houdini_icon.png"
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("zones_json",     "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("lighting_style", "string", widget_type="text", default="cinematic_industrial")
        self.add_input("scene_theme",    "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("plan_id",        "string")
        self.add_output("lighting_style", "string")
        self.add_output("key_strategy",   "any")
        self.add_output("rim_strategy",   "any")
        self.add_output("balance",        "any")
        self.add_output("operations",     "list")
        self.add_output("plan_json",      "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    def _empty(self, error=""):
        return {
            "plan_id": "", "lighting_style": "",
            "key_strategy": {}, "rim_strategy": {}, "balance": {},
            "operations": [], "plan_json": json.dumps({"error": error}),
            "exec_out": True,
        }

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        raw_zones     = (inputs.get("zones_json") or "{}").strip() or "{}"
        lighting_style = (inputs.get("lighting_style") or "cinematic_industrial").strip()
        scene_theme    = (inputs.get("scene_theme") or "").strip()

        try:
            zones = json.loads(raw_zones) if isinstance(raw_zones, str) else raw_zones
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            self.log_error(f"zones_json is not valid JSON: {exc}")
            return self._empty(error=f"invalid zones_json: {exc}")

        if not isinstance(zones, dict):
            self.log_error("zones_json must be a JSON object.")
            return self._empty(error="zones_json must be a JSON object")

        engine = get_semantic_lighting_engine()
        try:
            plan = engine.generate_lighting_plan(zones, lighting_style, scene_theme=scene_theme)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Lighting plan generation failed: {exc}")
            return self._empty(error=f"plan generation failed: {exc}")

        resolved_style = plan.get("lighting_style", lighting_style)
        self.log_info(f"Cinematic lighting plan generated: style={resolved_style}, ops={len(plan.get('operations', []))}")

        return {
            "plan_id":       plan.get("plan_id", ""),
            "lighting_style": resolved_style,
            "key_strategy":  plan.get("key_strategy", {}),
            "rim_strategy":  plan.get("rim_strategy", {}),
            "balance":       plan.get("balance", {}),
            "operations":    plan.get("operations", []),
            "plan_json":     json.dumps(plan, indent=2, default=str),
            "exec_out":      True,
        }


def register_node():
    return HouMCPCinematicLightingNode
